source_evidence_candidates.exact_quote: This particular survey has not been validated, although it is modelled on the Australian National Health Survey, with physical activity questions based on the IPAQ (SF) (Craig et al. 2003). This is described in lines 70 to 73 of the review PDF. Reference has been made to the IPAQ-SF in the Survey description section, lines 104 to 114 of the review PDF. The survey was piloted among staff and then students prior to administration; this statement has been added to line 114 of the review PDF. This survey has been administered to first year students every year since 2015 and was adapted to include the COVID-19-specific questions. A detailed description of the survey questions is provided in the methods section, and the response tables (Tables 1-4) provide an indication of the questions that were asked, and responses provided. Others wishing to replicate the survey could do so from those tables. Beyond this, the survey was provided to the reviewers as a supplementary file & we will make it available for readers, as a supplementary file. This statement has been added to line 114 of the review PDF.
